article.title: ElevenLabs為廣告本地化加入人工覆核
article.title_en: ElevenLabs adds human review to ad localization
article.summary: Ads Engine可安排語言及創意專家審閱譯文、配音與品牌規範。
article.summary_en: Ads Engine can route translations, dubbing and brand checks to language and creative specialists.
highlights: 語言專家可檢查譯文語氣和品牌名稱發音。
完成的素材可交回團隊審批。
highlights_en: Language reviewers can check tone and brand-name pronunciation.
Finished assets can return to the team for approval.
article.why: 跨市場團隊可預先指定哪些廣告需要當地語言審閱，並把品牌把關與投放批准分開。
article.why_en: Cross-market teams can define which ads need local-language review and separate brand checks from launch approval.
article.next_step: 先選一支影片，提供品牌名稱讀音、禁用措辭及最終審批人。
article.next_step_en: Start with one video and supply brand pronunciations, restricted wording and a named approver.
article.detail: 公告把生成素材、專家審閱與發佈列為不同步驟。廣告主可用品牌規範及既有素材作審閱參考，並指定誰負責最終決定。公司提供聯絡入口，未在公告列出收費、服務時間或各市場資格。安排大批量製作前，宜先用一組素材核對譯文、發音與回稿流程，並記錄需要修改的地方。
article.detail_en: The announcement separates asset generation, specialist review and publishing. Teams can supply brand guidelines and existing assets. The release provides a contact form without listing fees, turnaround or market eligibility. Use one set of assets to check translation, pronunciation and the review handoff before expanding.
